read_parquet.description: Read the full-month parquet and reduce to row count + fare total.

read_csv.description: Read the full-month CSV (typed read: timestamp column parsed/inferred).

groupby.description: Per-day aggregation: trips, total fare, mean distance, mean passengers.

join.description: Join trips to the zone lookup on pickup zone; aggregate fare by borough.

window.description: Top-5 pickup zones by trip count per day (window rank, deterministic ties).

filter.description: Filtered scan (predicate pushdown): fares > $50 and trips > 10 miles.

strings_groupby.description: String-categorical rollup: trips and fare per payment_type x vendor.

distinct_sort.description: Distinct-zone rollup sorted: top-10 pickup zones by fare (ties by trips, zone).

write_parquet.description: Write the full frame back to parquet in the engine's native path.

partitioned_read.description: Multi-file out-of-core style read: 31 per-day hive-partitioned parquet files.
